title: Sean McVay expects Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to be available Thursday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay expects Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to be available Thursday
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua and left tackle Alaric Jackson are both on the team's active roster on Monday and the team isn't expecting that to change ahead of their opener against the 49ers.
